metadata.description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for blockchainian's plugins: the feature pipeline (plan, orchestrate, verify, handoff), Grok and Codex review/delegation tooling, iOS debugging, profiling, and whole-screen capture on simulator or device, and the Render and Cloudflare plugins carrying only the skills this desk uses.

plugins.name: feature
plugins.description: Ship a feature from a written plan: orchestrate the codex and UX lanes to a merged, verified, deployed PR, with the planner, UX and UX-verifier agents, the handoff skill, and the no-blocking hooks.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Deliver a planned feature as parallel codex workstreams off Claude's critical path — merged onto your session branch and pushed — then review the delta into a findings file.

plugins.name: grok
plugins.description: Use the local Grok CLI from Claude Code for code review and task delegation.

plugins.name: build-ios-apps
plugins.description: Drive iOS apps from Claude Code: build, run, and inspect on the simulator via XcodeBuildMCP, capture symbolicated ETTrace flamegraphs, root-cause memory leaks from memgraphs, and capture whole app screens, from a simulator or a connected iPhone.

plugins.name: render
plugins.description: Deploy, debug, and monitor applications on Render: the Render MCP server over OAuth, the render-assistant agent, the render.yaml validation hook, and the nine Render skills for CLI, Blueprints, debugging, monitoring, env vars, Postgres, Key Value, disks, and MCP setup.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Skills for the Cloudflare developer platform: Workers, Durable Objects, Agents SDK, Wrangler CLI, and web performance, with the five Cloudflare MCP servers.
